name: tt-wang-cortex-plugin
description: Persistent, self-evolving memory plugin for Claude Code. Background miner extracts durable lessons (decisions, conventions, bug fixes) from completed sessions via Claude Haiku, stores them as human-readable markdown in an Obsidian vault, and assembles query-tailored context briefings at session start. Local-first, no cloud, no API keys. Self-healing install via uv bootstrap shim, `/cortex-doctor` preflight, graceful FTS-only degraded mode when `claude` CLI missing. MIT.
install:
# git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/TT-Wang/cortex-plugin
# See source for mcpServers config block
